origin.description: The source file (a reference) or the decision that produced this table (C04 R[0]); a table without it is code

description.description: What the table checks, in the pack language

tier.description: Tier of the outcomes (C05 R[1]); default blocking when a basis is given, else advisory. Blocking needs a basis

basis.description: The acceptance contract clause a blocking check relies on (C05 R[1])

item.description: Pointer to the item identity in the subject (or in each node); copied into outcomes

location.description: Pointer to the reference URI of the item in the judged source; becomes a ground of the outcomes

items.description: RFC 9535 JSONPath selecting values of the subject; only member names, indexes and wildcards are allowed

values.description: Subject locations whose values must be members (strings, or arrays of strings)

reference.description: A bound source whose content is a JSON array of strings

name.description: A closed set the pack declares (slots.schema.json), passed by the caller

set.description: A closed set by value, by reference or by the name of a pack-declared set

unicode.description: Unicode normalization form applied first; default nfc

case.description: insensitive compares lower-cased values; default sensitive

whitespace.description: trim removes leading and trailing whitespace, collapse also turns every inner whitespace run into one space; default trim

match.description: How values are normalized before matching (C04 R[2]); every table that compares text declares it

required.description: A required missing location refutes core.structure.required_empty with data.missing, attributed to the subject provider; an optional missing location is listed in data.missing, never unknown

title: membership@1
description: Membership table: values must belong to a closed set. Code: core.membership.not_in_set
